tasks.title: Prove Phase 8 read-only Mission Control end to end
tasks.prompt: Finish the Phase 8 core with a deterministic offline Mission Control probe. Add scripts/mission_control_probe.py that creates a temporary repository fixture containing representative state, checkpoint, task queue, metrics/failures, and one OPEN human decision; builds a MissionControlSnapshot; renders HTML; writes the build artifact; reloads snapshot.json; and proves no secret-like fixture value or raw decision context appears in snapshot or HTML. Assert the open decision is visible by id/question, progress counts are correct, a stale telemetry warning is present when metrics lag state, and the HTML contains no script tag or external resource URL. Print one compact JSON success record and exit 0; failures must exit nonzero without tracebacks. Add focused standard-library unittest coverage. Do not add dependencies or network calls. Run exactly PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v and PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/mission_control_probe.py before finishing.
